title: Grateful Dead Live at Assembly Hall, University Of Illinois on 1973-02-21

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a solid 1973 show with standout “Eyes of the World” and vibrant Brown Eyed Woman/Stella Blue, though some listeners note occasional drop‑outs.
ai_review.review: The Miller mix is widely regarded as a genuine SBD that delivers clear instrument separation and captures the band’s mid‑’70s vibe. While fans praise the performance – especially the “Eyes of the World” jam and the energy of Brown Eyed Woman and Stella Blue – a few note blips, drop‑outs, and an overall tentative feel in parts of the set.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars for performance and classify the source as a good soundboard, but several mention audible glitches that pull the overall rating down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally praised as a crisp SBD with stage‑mic bleed adding audience ambience; however, some listeners report blips, drop‑outs, and occasional muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set one features strong vocal moments (Donna) and a relaxed vibe; set two is shorter but includes a notable Truckin jam that morphs into Eyes of the World, giving the show a balanced pacing despite an overall tentative feel.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass work is noted, though some reviewers heard occasional drop‑outs during his lines.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir is mentioned for his onstage comment “Rockin' your socks off.”
